selected_by: AR-016: the only candidate; Bonferroni-adjusted overrules, chosen to fix the AR-014 multiple-testing failure (dev +0.360, detector +0.073; overrule false rejections outside confounded worlds 566 -> 0). This is the SECOND confirmatory test of this research line; confirm_1 failed and stays in the record.
world_and_seed_draw: secrets.randbits(30) at run time; recorded in the output
primary_metric: per-world gap = mean over its two configs of (CCL agreement - best of five fixed baselines, retrospective), points
inference: two-sided 95% t-interval over the 24 independent worlds
margin_justification: 0.25 points = 1 decision in 400. Against best-baseline error rates of about 0.1% to 0.3% this allows CCL up to roughly two to three times the errors of the best black box; it is a lenient margin, stated as such. A pass therefore means 'not much worse than the best of five fixed models on these synthetic worlds', nothing stronger.
success_rule: PASS iff the lower 95% bound of the per-world gap exceeds -0.25
reporting: the result is reported whatever it shows; no method or harness change between this manifest's commit and the run; one run only
